paragraphs.source_en: As we know, a portfolio comprised of 100% stocks—even in the broadly diversified VTSAX—is considered very aggressive. High short-term risk (read: gut wrenching volatility) rewarded with top long-term results. Perfect for those who can handle the ride, are adding new money to their investments and who take the long view.
